landingHeroBadge: Purpose-Built for Web Agencies & Digital Teams
landingHeroHeadline: Stay Ahead of Every Client Website.
landingHeroSubtitle: Monitor client websites and APIs, catch issues early, and keep every maintenance activity organized — all from one workspace.
landingHeroLiveStatus: All Systems Operational · 100% of monitored targets healthy
landingHeroEngineBadge: PostgreSQL Queue Scheduler (1s Polling) · 60s+ Check Intervals · Multi-layer SSRF Guard Active
landingCapabilitiesSubtitle: Reliable uptime monitoring, background heartbeat tracking, and transparent incident management — built specifically for teams managing client retainers.
landingCap1Desc: Automated HTTP and HTTPS checks with configurable intervals (from 60s). Continuous latency tracking, status code verification, and multi-layer SSRF guard protection.
landingCap2Desc: Track scheduled batch jobs, queue workers, and background scripts with unique ping URLs. Detect hung or silent worker failures before clients report missed operations.
landingCap3Desc: Instant incident alerts triggered on downtime. Acknowledge, assign, and document resolution timelines with complete audit logs and historical root cause notes.
landingCap4Desc: Consolidate every client portfolio, production website, staging domain, and API asset into a unified agency registry with primary technical and administrative contacts.
landingCap5Desc: Document scheduled updates, CMS patches, database optimizations, and emergency fixes. Build a transparent record of all retainer work to justify client care contracts.
landingCap6Desc: Enterprise data isolation via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS). Granular roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer) and tokenized client care reports with public sharing links.
landingHowSubtitle: Four straightforward steps to bring operational discipline to your client website portfolio.
landingStep1Desc: Add client profiles and associate their web applications, domains, and API endpoints.
landingStep2Desc: Set up automated HTTP checks and copy heartbeat ping URLs into your server crontabs.
landingStep3Desc: Our distributed scheduler continuously verifies service health and triggers incidents on failure.
landingStep4Desc: Log maintenance activities and generate verified performance summaries for your clients.
landingValueSubtitle: Generic uptime tools monitor single servers. ClientPulse is built around agency-client relationships.
landingVal1Desc: Eliminate fragmented spreadsheets and multi-tool logins. See the exact status of all client properties in one cohesive dashboard.
landingVal2Desc: Discover downtime, broken SSL certificates, and missing backups before your clients call you in frustration.
landingVal3Desc: Never mistake a halted background worker for a web server crash. Independent heartbeat monitoring keeps diagnostics precise.
landingVal4Desc: Transform invisible background maintenance into documented operational reports that prove the real ROI of your monthly retainer.
landingPreviewSubtitle: Take a look at the actual interface components used by development teams every day.
landingFinalCtaTitle: Take Control of Your Client Websites.
landingFinalCtaSubtitle: Equip your agency with the operational visibility needed to deliver dependable uptime and maintenance care.

landingFooterDesc: The dedicated website monitoring and client care management platform for web development agencies.
